question: Do actual omitted-output residuals, or innovations remaining after the frozen R256, vary less across real spatial neighbours than across matched distant tokens?
sources: All24 original OP2 sources, already development/training exposed; no new source split or quality evaluation.
data: Original sampled post-Q1 V1, BaseY, StudentY, TeacherY, gate and actual selected native coordinates; payload SHA256 and decoded tensor geometry required.
primary_graph: Undirected right/down cardinal neighbours within the same latent frame; inspect only edges with both endpoints actually sampled. Never join sampled offsets as spatial neighbours.
secondary_graph: All observed unordered pairs in the same horizontal1x4 stripe. This is partial pair evidence, not a fully observed four-token action.
far_control: For each directed observed near edge, deterministic nearest eligible saved offset at the same source/frame and Manhattan distance>=8 from the target; no labels used to choose it.
primary_observables: FP64 gated target residual energy, donor residual energy, cross product and unshrunk residual-copy error
CPU BF16 add/gate-product error from original BF16 outputs, separately from the FP64 identity
Near/far contrast and per-source coverage; pairwise effective sample size is not token or independent-source count
Pre-W1 post-Q1 input cosine/L2 difference and its descriptive relation to residual-copy benefit; no predictor fitted
secondary_observables: Global scalar projection coefficient dot/anchor_energy is descriptive geometry only, not a trained policy or a new model result. Report it without using it to trigger a model job.
operator_hypothesis: A calibrated quarter-width backbone on all rows plus full original FFN on one-quarter current-step anchors, sharing only residual innovations. MainMAC=.25+.25=.5 including duplicate backbone work at anchors. Preserve the existing calibration instead of stripping it as D0 did.
layout_scope: Observed21x29x52 grid admits exactly7917 horizontal1x4 anchors. A naive2x2 ceil tiling needs8190 anchors and exceeds50% when combined with a quarter backbone.
important_mismatch: Only OP2 step0 has the quarter-width backbone. Other steps remain conditional comparisons on their frozen50/50/75% backbones. No claim that a quarter backbone plus anchors is already measured across four steps.

opposite_results.support: Near residuals are more coherent than far controls and sharing reduces actual saved-output gated error on multiple sources; next question is legal input-conditioned anchor choice and full stripe/native execution.
opposite_results.reject_this_transfer: Near residuals are not coherent or copying raises error; do not run a zero-order neighbour-sharing model on that evidence. Examine which component lost coherence before inventing a different operator.

limits: No new FFN/model forward, quantizer invocation, fitted weights, rollout, quality or timing. Pair statistics cannot establish four-token coverage, anchor policy value, exact reducedM GEMM identity, or complete FFN speed.
